One-day mini world change in the Tiquanda jungle: the Ape God has frightened the elephants, and in a small clearing south of Banuta {creature:Terrified Elephant|Terrified Elephants} appear. They drop {item:Elephant Tusk|Elephant Tusks} more often than normal elephants, and killing 5 gives the achievement **Trail of the Ape God**.
Something has left a group of Elephants terrified in the jungle.
Clearing in the Tiquanda jungle, south of Banuta
The mini world change must be active on your server (it lasts one day).
Higher chance to loot {item:Elephant Tusk|Elephant Tusks}
Keep an eye on the daily messages: if you see one of the phrases in section 1, the mini world change is active.
Bring antidotes or the {spell:Cure Poison} spell: there are several poisonous creatures in the jungle.
Bring a {item:Machete}: in the Tiquanda jungle it comes in handy for cutting the vegetation (jungle grass) that blocks some paths.
When the Stampede is active, these messages appear in the game:

Take the boat to **Port Hope** (there are boats from Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay and Edron): talk to the port captain and say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Charles}'s dock in Port Hope.

Leave Port Hope and cross the **Tiquanda** jungle to the **east**, to the area **south of Banuta** (Banuta is north of the clearing, at {coord:32807,32542,7}). The area where the elephants appear is small and almost free of vegetation, with up to **16** {creature:Terrified Elephant|Terrified Elephants}.
On the way you may run into {creature:Wasp|Wasps}, {creature:Centipede|Centipedes}, {creature:Crocodile|Crocodiles}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas} and {creature:Carniphila|Carniphilas}.

Kill at least **5** {creature:Terrified Elephant|Terrified Elephants} to earn the **Trail of the Ape God** achievement. Keep hunting if you want more {item:Elephant Tusk|Elephant Tusks}: these elephants drop them more often than normal {creature:Elephant|Elephants}.

When you're done, head back to **Port Hope** the same way, to the **west** through the jungle. There you can take {npc:Charles}'s boat to your city (say {key:hi} and the city name, for example {key:thais}, and {key:yes}).
